title: A new family of Ln7 clusters with an ideal D3h metal-centered trigonal prismatic geometry, and SMM and photoluminescence behaviors

synthesis.procedure: sachH2 was prepared in 85% yield by 1:1 condensation of 2-aminocyclohexanol (cis/trans mixture) with salicylaldehyde in refluxing absolute methanol. Reaction of Gd(ClO4)3·6H2O, sachH2, and Me4NOH·5H2O in a 1:3:3 molar ratio in MeOH under aerobic conditions gave a deep yellow solution; slow evaporation at room temperature afforded yellowish crystals of 1. CO3^2− is attributed to atmospheric CO2 fixation.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature (slow evaporation); ligand condensation in refluxing methanol
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic solution reaction followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: slow evaporation of the deep yellow MeOH solution at room temperature gave yellowish crystals

properties.summary: Heptanuclear Gd7 cluster with weak intramolecular antiferromagnetic coupling; magnetization saturates near 48.9 μB. No metal-centered emission; ligand-centered UV-vis absorptions are shifted upon coordination. Cluster remains intact in MeCN (ESI-MS).

properties.summary: Anisotropic Tb7 cluster; χMT decreases at low T from depopulation of Stark sublevels and weak AF interactions. No out-of-phase ac signals down to 1.8 K (not an SMM under these conditions). Strong green Tb-centered photoluminescence in MeCN via ligand antenna effect, with residual ligand fluorescence from back-energy transfer.

properties.summary: Dy7 SMM with frequency-dependent χ″ tails below ~10 K under zero dc field; estimated barrier ~1.2 cm−1 (~1.7 K) and τ0 = 0.2×10−6 s. Strong blue emission in MeCN combining ligand fluorescence with Dy-centered 4F9/2→6HJ bands.
